text:
This photo shows leftovers after a meal, so I estimated only what remains.

- Banana: it appears to be a whole banana, but the peel looks open and the fruit may be partly eaten. I counted about 100 g of edible fruit, roughly 90 kcal.
- Muffin remnant: about 40 g of a partly eaten muffin, roughly 150 kcal.
- Raisin bread: about 40 g, roughly 110 kcal.
- Residue on the plate and bowls (egg, oatmeal, syrup, and similar): about 30 g, roughly 50 kcal.

Totals: about 410 kcal over about 210 g. I lowered the banana estimate to allow for the banana possibly being partly eaten, which gives a final figure of about 400 kcal and 200 g.
